name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Ethiopian and Eritrean forces reportedly traded artillery fire near Badme on 11–13 Nov; control of the town is disputed
state: Ethiopian federal and Eritrean forces reportedly exchanged artillery fire around Badme on 11–13 Nov, accounts differ on who holds the town, and Eritrea's information ministry accused Ethiopia of invading (Critical Threats, 13 Nov). Federal and Tigrayan forces also clashed around Rama and near Axum on 7–11 Nov, and G7 foreign ministers called for restraint on 11 Nov. Ethiopia and Eritrea cut diplomatic ties on 2 Oct (Africanews). Interstate fighting is reported but unconfirmed, so Watch holds.
for_you: Little direct risk to UK readers; the FCDO advises against travel to parts of Ethiopia and the Eritrean border, so check its travel advice. A wider war would add to displacement in the Horn of Africa, near Red Sea shipping lanes.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant deterioration not tracked elsewhere — Ethiopia–Eritrea clashes near Badme reported but unconfirmed

sources.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea sever ties as Tigray fighting intensifies
